fichas.title: UK Structure Gauges and Clearances
fichas.summary: Diagrams and notes specify minimum lateral and overhead clearances for railway tracks and structures, including platform clearances. The stated clearances apply to straight, level track unless otherwise noted; adjustments are required for curvature and cant. Dimensions are in millimetres. The standard structure gauge accommodates overhead electrification up to 25 kV.
uses: Set minimum clearances for construction, reconstruction, and alterations to track and structures
Coordinate trackside structures and overhead electrification

dimensions.label: Platform clearance from edge to nearest building structure or platform furniture
dimensions.context: Minimum for line speeds up to 165 km/h.
dimensions.ocr_raw: shall be 2500mm for speeds up to 165km/h

dimensions.label: Platform clearance from edge to nearest building structure or platform furniture
dimensions.context: Minimum for line speeds greater than 165 km/h.
dimensions.ocr_raw: for speeds greater than 165km/h the minimum dimension shall be 3000 mm

dimensions.label: Clearance to face of any column
dimensions.context: Minimum distance from the platform edge to the face of any column.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The minimum distance to the face of any column shall be 2000mm.

dimensions.label: Preferred clearance from rail level to underside of structures
dimensions.context: Preferred increase for overhead equipment design flexibility; greater clearance may be required in some locations.
dimensions.ocr_raw: the minimum dimension between rail level and the underside of the structures should be increased, preferably to 4780mm or more

dimensions.label: Vertical clearance to platform canopy
dimensions.context: Up to 2000 mm minimum from the platform edge, for line speeds up to 165 km/h.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Vertical clearances to the canopy above the platform shall be 2500mm up to 2000mm minimum from the platform edge

dimensions.label: Vertical clearance to platform canopy
dimensions.context: Up to 2000 mm minimum from the platform edge where line speed exceeds 165 km/h.
dimensions.ocr_raw: or up to 3000mm where the line speed exceeds 165km/h

dimensions.label: Minimum headroom beyond applicable platform-edge zone
dimensions.context: At distances beyond 2000 mm or 3000 mm from the platform edge, as applicable.
dimensions.ocr_raw: At distances beyond 2000mm or 3000mm from the platform edge, as applicable, the minimum headroom shall be 2300mm.

dimensions.label: Guidance minimum lateral platform dimension
dimensions.context: Platform clearance subject to HMRI stepping distances and the particular kinematic envelope.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The minimum lateral dimension is 730mm and is shown for guidance.

dimensions.label: Increase to clearance dimensions where practicable
dimensions.context: Increase to facilitate an access walkway.
dimensions.ocr_raw: these dimensions shall be increased by 300 mm

dimensions.label: Height above rail level for applicable lower structure gauge diagram
dimensions.context: Diagram applies at and below this height above rail level (ARL).
dimensions.ocr_raw: Standard structure gauge applicable at and below 1089 mm above rail level (ARL)

dimensions.label: Maximum height for bridge girders, dwarf signals, and other lineside equipment in platform space
dimensions.ocr_raw: up to a height of 915mm ARL

dimensions.label: Horizontal stepping distance
dimensions.context: Maximum, calculated from the centre of the bottom of the door opening, unless dispensation is sought.

dimensions.label: Vertical stepping distance
dimensions.context: Maximum, calculated from the centre of the bottom of the door opening, unless dispensation is sought.

dimensions.label: Diagonal stepping distance
dimensions.context: Maximum, calculated from the centre of the bottom of the door opening, unless dispensation is sought.

dimensions.context: Diagram dimension; a starred alternative is printed for higher line speeds.
